documents.body:
LEGAL NOTICE

To,
Mr. Suresh Gowda
[LANDLORD ADDRESS / KORAMANGALA, BANGALORE]

Subject: Demand for refund of security deposit amounting to ₹80,000 upon vacation of premises.

Dear Sir,

I, [YOUR NAME], former tenant of your property situated at Koramangala, Bangalore under the 11-month rental agreement, state as follows:

1. That I occupied the said premises under a rental agreement and duly paid a security deposit of ₹80,000 via bank transfer.
2. That I peacefully vacated and handed over vacant possession of the premises to you on 5 September 2026.
3. That despite more than two months having elapsed since the vacation of the premises, you have wrongfully withheld the entire security deposit of ₹80,000 under the pretext of painting charges, without providing any itemized bills, receipts, or valid justification, resulting in financial loss and breach of obligations [[ICA1872:s73]].

Therefore, pursuant to the terms and obligations regarding compensation for breach [[ICA1872:s73]], I call upon you to refund the full security deposit of ₹80,000 to my bank account within [NUMBER] days of receiving this notice, failing which I shall be constrained to pursue appropriate legal remedies available under the law.

Sincerely,

[YOUR NAME]
[YOUR CONTACT INFORMATION]
[YOUR BANK DETAILS FOR REFUND]
